theme: Ephemeral Decay Mutator & Quantum Swap Protocol

deliverables_in_scope.title: Optional "Ephemeral Protocol" mutator toggle (`[KeyM]` or pre-match toggle): each contender may only maintain at most 3 active sigils on the lattice at once—when a contender inscribes their 4th sigil, their oldest sigil on the lattice dissolves back into a vacant sector, making Equilibrium Deadlocks impossible!
Shimmering half-life decay indicators and disintegration particle motes on whichever sigil is queued to vanish next under Ephemeral Protocol.
Diegetic turn-order age pips (`1`, `2`, `3`) subtly etched into the corner of each occupied sector so both contenders can read the decay queue at a glance.
